objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: square, triangular and honeycomb n x n tori for n = 6, 8, 10, 12 and 16, re-routed at random sets built from the torus or from its line network by 4 n^2 random face-boundary toggles kept when the result is a network, four seeds each; read persistence, flips, non-degeneracy, the plain first need, single fastest ways and ring-graph balls, testing that random re-routings keep every contact persistent with no flip, that none reads its distance plainly, and that small rings are late.
title: Re-routed lattice tori: a census
